g.text: When Is the Best Day to Buy a Pumpkin?

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #808080

g.text: Daily pumpkin price forecasts for October 2026, with 95% prediction intervals

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 10.666667px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #808080

g.text: Model: OLS of log advertised price on season effects and a cubic in days to Halloween; selected by rolling-origin backtest (2016-2025).

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 10.666667px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #808080

g.text: Data: USDA AMS Weekly Grocery Store Specialty Crops Feature Activity (national, carving pumpkins, each). Forecast cutoff October 23, 2026.

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 10.666667px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #808080

g.text: Prices are weighted-average advertised prices, not transaction prices. Ads run weekly, so day-to-day values are modelled, not observed.

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 10.666667px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #808080

g.text: The band is a 95% prediction interval for the national average advertised price on each day.

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 10.666667px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #808080

g.text: Forecast generated using Jenner Analytics, a SAS-compatible statistical computing platform.
